description: List all calendars in the authenticated user's calendar list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has kind and an 'items' list of calendar objects.

description: Get a single calendar by its id; 'primary' resolves to the primary calendar.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the calendar object; on failure (calendar not found), output contains an error message.

description: List events in a calendar with optional time-window, search, ordering, and pagination.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

time_min.description: Optional lower bound (inclusive) on event end time (RFC3339).

time_max.description: Optional upper bound (inclusive) on event start time (RFC3339).

q.description: Optional free-text search over summary, description, and location.

single_events.description: Whether to expand recurring events into single instances (default true).

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 25).

page_token.description: Optional pagination token (an integer offset) from a previous response.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has kind, an 'items' list of serialized events, and nextPageToken; on failure (calendar not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single event by calendar id and event id.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized event; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new event in a calendar.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

start.description: Event start as a time block: {dateTime, timeZone} for timed events or {date} for all-day events.

end.description: Event end as a time block: {dateTime, timeZone} for timed events or {date} for all-day events.

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee objects (email, displayName, responseStatus, optional, organizer).

recurrence.description: Optional list of RRULE recurrence strings.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created serialized event; on failure (calendar not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing event by calendar id and event id.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

event_id.description: The id of the event to update.

attendees.description: Optional new list of attendee objects (replaces existing attendees).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated serialized event; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete an event by calendar id and event id.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id, or 'primary' for the primary calendar.

event_id.description: The id of the event to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Query free/busy information across one or more calendars within a time window.

calendar_ids.description: List of calendar ids to query (each may be 'primary').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has kind, timeMin, timeMax, and a 'calendars' map of per-calendar busy blocks (or notFound errors).
